title: Peer-to-peer rental of stuff
summary: Rent a drill, tent or camera from your neighbour.
whyItFails: Low item value. Cheap items aren't worth renting. Logistics friction. Coordinating pickup and return is a hassle. Trust and damage. Insurance and disputes are costly.
whatWouldChange: Lockers or delivery that remove coordination friction.

attempts.notes: London peer-to-peer rental of cameras, tools and more; sold for $41.5 million.

attempts.outcome: Shut down as funding dried up

attempts.notes: Peer-to-peer car rental in the UK.
